title: [API] Error rate by level
description:
**What it shows:** API warnings and errors per 5 minutes, from the API logs.

**Healthy:** Few or none.

**If not:** A rise in errors: read the [API] Recent logs panel. See the [log reference](https://docs.powersync.com/debugging/log-reference) for what each message means.

targets.expression: filter level in ["warn", "error", "fatal"] | stats count() as count by bin(5m), level

title: [Replicator] Error rate by level
description:
**What it shows:** Replicator warnings and errors per 5 minutes, from the replicator logs.

**Healthy:** Few or none.

**If not:** A rise in errors: read the [Replicator] Recent logs panel. Errors here often come with Replication lag. See the [log reference](https://docs.powersync.com/debugging/log-reference).

targets.expression: filter level in ["warn", "error", "fatal"] | stats count() as count by bin(5m), level

title: [API] Recent logs
description:
**What it shows:** The latest API log lines.

**Healthy:** Mostly info lines, for example sync streams starting and completing.

**If not:** Search an error code in the [error codes](https://docs.powersync.com/debugging/error-codes). Also see [Troubleshooting](https://docs.powersync.com/debugging/troubleshooting).

title: [Replicator] Recent logs
description:
**What it shows:** The latest replicator log lines.

**Healthy:** Mostly info lines about replicated changes and checkpoints.

**If not:** Search an error code in the [error codes](https://docs.powersync.com/debugging/error-codes). Also see [Troubleshooting](https://docs.powersync.com/debugging/troubleshooting).
